product.description: The FitPulse FlexBand 15 is a versatile resistance band designed for strength training, flexibility, and rehabilitation. Constructed from high‑density rubber and a durable latex core, the band offers a smooth, consistent tension across its 120‑cm length. It features a reinforced handle loop and a quick‑release strap for easy transitions between exercises. Ideal for home workouts, physical therapy, or travel, the FlexBand 15 supports a wide range of movements, from bicep curls and shoulder presses to hip abductions and core twists. Its lightweight design and ergonomic grip make it suitable for all fitness levels, while the vibrant red color adds a splash of motivation to any routine.
